REDIS_AUTH.description: Redis password (requirepass). Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by langfuse-web and langfuse-worker as ${{redis.REDIS_AUTH}}.

REDIS_PORT.description: Redis server listening port. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{redis.REDIS_PORT}}.

REDIS_HOST.description: Redis internal hostname. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{redis.REDIS_HOST}}.
